### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows page not found (404) instead of the widgets page (200).

### Why it is broken

The part that matches web addresses to pages compares addresses without first putting them in a standard form, so `/widgets/`, with its final slash, does not match its page. A test confirmed this cause.

### How to fix it

Put addresses in a standard form before matching, so `/widgets/` reaches the same page as `/widgets`. This is expected to make `/widgets/` load. Choose hotfix because the change is small and safe.
